name: Course A
languageDirective: Deliver the course in English using clear, academically accurate language suitable for learners new to realist evaluation. Introduce specialist terms in full before using abbreviations, including Context–Mechanism–Outcome (CMO). Use plain-language explanations and a practical example to scaffold understanding while retaining standard realist evaluation terminology.
